//: A RACE BASE: the body every naga character extends, itself a difference against human (whose rig, loco states and clip library it inherits). Generated bare -- no hair, crown, horns, tail or pack, since a character cannot remove a limb it inherits -- from the default body made naga (`node scripts/gen_mobs.mjs naga --race-base`). Race-wide sidecar traits go HERE and reach every naga: the anatomy recipe, the bleed. Its .vox does not: each character wears its own art. Written by the Characters page or by `node scripts/gen_mobs.mjs naga --rebake`, from the `genome` block at the bottom. Do not hand-edit: re-roll it.

tread.//: TREADING WATER on a tail: upright, hands sculling in front at chest height twice a cycle, the tail hanging straight down beneath and kicking (the slither.water wave). Generated (serpent.js clips).

swim.//: SWIMMING FORWARD on a tail: a mermaid's stroke. Both arms reach ahead, sweep out and back to the sides, glide along the body, draw up the chest and shoot forward again, while the tail drives from the hips down. The hips' 70.9-degree pitch and 0.3 m lift are the human crawl's (pose.cpp kSwimCrawlPitch is stated about them).

swim_back.//: SWIMMING BACKWARD on a tail: upright, leaning back 15 degrees, both hands pushing the water away in front and sweeping round; the tail beneath does the work.

swim_side.//: SWIMMING SIDEWAYS on a tail, travelling to the body's RIGHT: leaning into the travel, the leading (right) arm reaching out overhead and pulling down to the hip, the other sculling at the chest. The left is swim_side.mirror.

swim_up.//: SWIMMING UP on a tail: upright, chin up, the arms reaching overhead and pulling down and out to the sides, the tail driving beneath.

swim_down.//: SWIMMING DOWN on a tail: a head-first dive, the hips pitched 115 degrees like the human's, the arms pulling toward the tail.

swim_side.mirror.//: swim_side, travelling LEFT: the mirror of swim_side (every .L/.R part swapped and every rotation reflected through the body's midplane, as the clip library derives one).

coil.//: ASLEEP on a tail: the trail curls into a spiral, the torso slumps over it, the arms fold. Held by the `sleep` activity state.
